{{Top|leg}}
A '''hyperspace control integrator''' was a component of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Because of the number of modifications aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], its hyperspace control integrator needed regular realignment.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
